title: Hearty Dense Malaysian Natto Curry
description: A comforting and flavorful Malaysian curry featuring natto, caramelized onions, and pescatarian-friendly ingredients, perfect for a cold winter night. This dish is jammy, dense, and packed with nutrients.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat and caramelize the onions for 20 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger to the pan and cook for 2 minutes.
Stir in the curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add the natto, coconut milk, shrimp, fish sauce, and brown sugar to the pan and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 15 minutes or until the shrimp are pink and cooked through.
Season the curry with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the curry hot over rice or noodles.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro or scallions if desired.
